notes.title: Should I start talking to you guys? Probably
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It has been a good while since I uploaded the Steam page for Escape Him, and I feel like I've heavily neglected all the lovely people who decided to wishlist this based on very little information. Hi! How are you? Are you excited to find out some more about the game you've showed interest in? Good!

The first thing to share, is that I've had some kind of a writer's block for this game, for a good few months. It's been partially due to a bit of a messy life schedule with a lack of routine, but mostly, i just don't know how to progress from the place where I currently am in the creative process. This is something I'm intending to sit with now that my life around this is just, in general less messy, and hopefully I'll be able to upload a fun, strong demo of the game in the coming little bit of time. I hope so. 

Other than the writers block, I've in general just not had time to work on the project for a good long bit. That part will, with the start of this lovely year 2025 be fixed, as I simply will have time to do things that aren't my day job. 

Looking forwards to talking to you! Again! Soon! 

//Buck
